$ naga check model.json --junit report.xml
model.json:
  [PASS] assertion     server_not_saturated: ok
  [PASS] assertion     wait_under_five_minutes: ok
  [FAIL] assertion     wait_under_two_minutes: assertion 'wait_under_two_minutes' failed: resource/Server/Time in Queue Avg = 2.86501 [2.30459, 3.42543] <= 2.0
  laws: 5 passed, 0 warning(s)
exit code: 1
$ naga ci-template --path models/
# Generated by `naga ci-template`. Runs every model's assertions and
# reality checks on push/PR: a merge that regresses a KPI
# an assertion pins, or breaks a reality-check constraint, fails CI.
# `naga check` is engine-side, so installing the engine alone is enough;
# change the install step with `naga ci-template --install "<command>"`.
name: Model checks

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  naga-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install naga
        run: |
          pip install .
      - name: naga check
        run: |
          shopt -s globstar nullglob
          models=("models/"/**/*.json)
          if [ ${#models[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "no *.json models under models/"
            exit 0
          fi
          naga check "${models[@]}" --junit naga-check.xml
      - name: Upload JUnit report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: naga-check-results
          path: naga-check.xml
